svg.title: Lead vocal EQ curve
svg.desc: A frequency response curve showing a high-pass at 100 hertz, a mud cut near 320 hertz, a clarity lift near 3 kilohertz, a small air lift near 9 kilohertz, and a low-pass roll-off at 15 kilohertz.

g.text: Curve shape only — exact dB values to be set by ear in Filter Curve EQ
Fundamental 175.8 Hz · real voice ends ~3.5 kHz · 8–15 kHz hump = artifact
